about: Evaluation cases. Purchase answers are worked out from the policy rules in code at scoring time, so they stay right if the company data changes. Question answers list phrases, any one of which must appear, and the document that must be cited.

cases.text: We need 20 standard laptops for the new Engineering hires in Pune, budget 15 lakh.
cases.tests: stock first, two approvers, three quotes

cases.text: 10 standard laptops for the Mumbai Sales team, budget 8 lakh.
cases.tests: transfer from another office instead of buying
